summary: Add an opt-in owned Darwin launchd lifecycle for the minimal light-node agent

replay.detail: Service operations preserve existing durable session and native custody journals; no graph replay is added.

schema.detail: Existing private agent configuration and session protocol are unchanged.

rules.detail: No home or executor grant scope, planner or graph effect authority changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing Linux service behavior remains unchanged; Darwin service actions are explicit GUI-user opt-in and refuse conflicting definitions.

downtime.detail: Installing this change performs no production activation. Explicit service stop or restart unloads only the owned agent and preserves native processes.

manual.detail: Operators separately provision private configuration and choose service installation/start or opt-in Home Manager activation; no TCC grants or whole-node migration are performed.

recovery.detail: Stop and uninstall preserve native state and the durable journal. Restart resumes existing custody; foreign or mismatched launchd jobs require explicit operator resolution.
